Patient is having approximately 6–7 stools per day
Intermittent crampy left lower quadrant abdominal pain
Felt hot at onset of illness about 3–4 days ago

Assessment.content: Three days of watery diarrhea 6–7 times per day
Intermittent crampy left lower quadrant abdominal pain associated with the illness
Transient feverishness at onset of illness
Possible foodborne exposure from Chinese takeaway

Plan_of_Care.content: Encourage oral fluid intake for hydration
Consider Dioralyte, especially for the first couple of days
Plan_of_Care.source_text: consider Dioralyte, esp first couple of days

Plan_of_Care.content: Use paracetamol 2 tablets up to 4 times per day for the first few days if feeling feverish or weak
Plan_of_Care.source_text: Symptomatic: paracetamol 2 tablets up to 4×/day for first few days if feverish/weak

Plan_of_Care.content: Patient to be off work for 2–3 days
If not improved in 3–4 days, consider stool sample testing
Plan_of_Care.source_text: F/U if not improved in 3–4 days; consider stool sample testing

Follow_up_Information.content: Follow up if not improved in 3–4 days
